whatItIs: jquil is an open-source project in the compilers and languages category. It is maintained by QCHackers and primarily looks like a Java codebase. Open ~/.jquilconfig.properties and enter your Forest User Id and API key:

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches compilers and languages workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: Open ~/.jquilconfig.properties and enter your Forest User Id and API key: You can get an API key from Rigetti Forest if you don't have one.
whoItsFor: Developers who want to understand the representations and compilers that sit between high-level code and runnable circuits.
